producer_writer_exit.producer: Swift defaults to -backend=at and has no direct QMI RPC call in the reviewed Swift source. Explicit QMI mode exposes five typed QMI actions only through the authenticated private .in Unix socket; public and .rs listeners reject bare /api/internal and every /api/internal/ descendant before token admission. Main retains the optional retry worker only in QMI mode. Default AT launch does not prove QMI reachability; other internal consumers remain unresolved.
producer_writer_exit.format: POST JSON is limited to 16 KiB. Open has a typed control_path; close, probe and operator require an empty object; set-ims denies unknown fields and an empty update. QMI core encodes service/client/transaction/message/TLV packets before a serialized transport write.
producer_writer_exit.writer: QmiState mutex serializes session selection/publication; macOS libusb claims one candidate and writes QMI frames to selected bulk endpoint after CTL_SYNC.
producer_writer_exit.exit: Typed actions hold the QMI operation gate and state mutex through their result; private close fences retry. Session close aggregates IMS/NAS/UIM and USB client result; client stops transport and joins reader; retry lifecycle stops/joins worker; main retains report. Unknown physical cleanup blocks reopen.

unresolved: Historical macOS QMI/MBIM supported models, firmware and operations are not recoverable from this current-code trace alone.

This static successor audit establishes no QMI CTL_SYNC/service/USB cleanup or hotplug execution. The i667 DJI/CTExcel AT-based IMS registration subset does not validate the QMI transport or other hardware/carrier combinations.

Swift now defaults to -backend=at and projects /api/status, with no direct call to the reviewed private QMI routes. Explicit QMI consumers, default-launch QMI reachability and historical support membership remain UNRESOLVED_NOT_PASS.
Set-ims can have an UNKNOWN modem outcome after a submitted request loses its response; this static trace does not authorize replay or award a successful setting.
Operator EF-AD read failure can be hidden by empty AD and a default MNC length of 2; NAS name read failure can be hidden by an empty name, so 200 does not prove those reads or carrier identity.
Other P0 producer/writer/exit families, UIM business scope and the formal device/card/carrier instance registry remain outside this finite slice.
